get_model_checkpoint_loader: get the resolved ModelCheckpointLoader instance from the dependency resolver
lazy_load_checkpoint: lazily load model checkpoint parameters from a path yielding name tensor pairs one at a time
supports_path_check: check if a ModelCheckpointLoader can handle a given checkpoint file path
create_load_options: create ModelCheckpointLoadOptions with mmap restrict and state_dict_converter settings for checkpoint loading
handle_corrupt_checkpoint: handle CorruptModelCheckpointError exceptions when a checkpoint file is erroneous and cannot be loaded
